source_failure.failed_measurement_assumption: one zero-shot NLI primitive can authoritatively measure all SCEC compatibility dimensions, coverage, and polarity through hypothesis competition

core_decisions: Retain SCEC's conceptual separation of compatibility, sufficiency, polarity, deterministic relation mapping, and claim composition.
Retire universal whole-pair zero-shot NLI hypothesis competition as the authoritative measurement of every SCEC dimension.
Represent each claim atom and candidate evidence proposition as typed proposition frames with explicit core and qualifier slots.
Evaluate MATCH, MISMATCH, or UNSPECIFIED slot relations with typed comparison rather than one universal semantic labeler.
Treat explicit mandatory mismatches as compatibility vetoes and unspecified required content as a coverage gap rather than a contradiction.
Construct an evidence coverage graph so complementary compatible propositions can jointly satisfy decisive claim slots.
Evaluate support or refutation only after scope alignment and sufficiency are established.
Permit specialized deterministic or separately validated learned logic for explicit negation, value conflict, temporal relations, and residual semantic equivalence.
Preserve existing AERF atoms and forbid verifier-adaptive free-form redecomposition in this checkpoint.
